correctness.rationale: The spectral/nuclear dual maximum over two probability simplices is exact (extreme nuclear rank-one). Matrix fidelity is jointly concave via an explicit infimum over positive matrices. Dephased complex Hadamard orthogonality makes the identical-weight stationary point global without transitivity assumptions: the nonspecial gradient components coincide and the restricted symmetric derivative vanishes. The 2×2 exceptional compression plus n−2 flat singular values yields F(y)=(a+√(y²+2(d+h)y+1))/(y+d), whose derivative has a unique positive zero for n≥3. Its tangency equation yields the printed radical; n=2 ζ=−1 is handled directly. Differentiating at ζ=1 supplies exact θ² coefficient. Independent unrestricted weight optimizations check 25 finite examples; do not replace uniform analytic argument.

The known ζ=−1 result is an endpoint, not newly claimed.
